MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

2. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

3. When learning Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

4. When learning Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.

5. When learning Introduction to Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

7. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Photography.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

9. When learning Pre - Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre - Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre - Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre - Production.

10. When learning Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

11. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.

12. When learning Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.

13. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.

14. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

15. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.

16. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
